recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Black Flame Coven Bash as a single-file, mobile-first browser canvas game. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: first-person perspective enemies spawn at distance and advance; tapping/clicking an enemy hitbox removes it and increments score; holding the WARD button or shaking/moving the device applies retreat pressure; contact removes health; zero health stops gameplay and shows a restart overlay. Transform presentation into a Hocus Pocus-style Halloween coven party with mischievous witch sisters, black-flame cauldron, glowing spellbook, candlelit folklore, comic spooky tone, procedural pumpkins/bats/bunting, readable portrait HUD, and touch-safe controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: first-person mobile survival tap-shooter / proximity defense arcade game
- objective: tap approaching enemies before they reach the player, while using a hold/shake retreat action to buy distance and preserve health
- input model: tap/click canvas to attack, hold touch/click WARD/RUN button to retreat, optional device-motion shake adds retreat energy, start/restart buttons use normal click/tap
- core loop: start -> optional camera/fallback scene -> spawn entity at distance -> entity advances with perspective scaling -> player taps hitbox to remove and score -> contact removes health -> zero health opens game-over and restart
- fail/friction state: each enemy reaching near z distance removes 20 health; at 0 health active loop stops and terminal overlay appears

## Protected Mechanics
- Perspective projection, z-distance advance, spawn interval, score-on-hit, health-on-contact, game-over/restart semantics, tap hitbox targeting, hold-button retreat, motion retreat, mobile portrait actionability.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD wording, title, entity drawing, attack feedback, background, particles, color/font system, audio oscillator tone, start/game-over copy, and the camera fallback visual scene are safe to transform.

## Remix Trajectory
The game becomes Black Flame Coven Bash: a Hocus Pocus-inspired camp Halloween party where mischievous sisters rush the candle circle and the player pops hexes with a spellbook while keeping the black flame alive.
